selection_rules: phot_g_mean_mag < 16; finite parallax and parallax_error > 0; parallax / parallax_error > 5; ruwe < 1.4
distance_policy: Use positive Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot distance estimates as published; do not invert parallax. Missing or non-positive estimates are null.
limitations: One Gaia DR3 source chunk, not a complete stellar census. Quality cuts select a biased subset; GSP-Phot distances retain their source uncertainties.
attribution: ESA/Gaia/DPAC; include the required Gaia DR3 acknowledgment and citation.
license: Gaia Archive source terms; verify attribution and redistribution terms before publication.
